_comment: Identity of the pcp plug-in for every host install file. Skill and command text come from pcp.yaml via render_skill.py. Edit this, then run python3 build/adapters.py.
name: pcp
description: Pre-call prep: a few one-time setup questions, research from public sources by targeted web search (LinkedIn only as its public search results show it, never your browser), plus your own files when you give them, and ONE 3-page PDF: a 2-page Intelligence Brief and a 1-page meeting script. Every fact cited.

marketplace.name: talyx
marketplace.description: Free plug-ins from Talyx AI for advisors and professional-services firms.

interface.longDescription: Sets up once, then researches the person, company or deal you are about to meet from public sources found by targeted web search, LinkedIn only as its public search results show it (never your browser), and your own files when you give them, and renders one 3-page PDF: a 2-page Intelligence Brief and a 1-page meeting script. Every fact carries a source; what it could not find becomes a question to ask in the room.
defaultPrompt: Prep me for my call with Jane Doe at Acme Capital.
